meta.purpose: The closed policy set. This is the only source of truth the answering assistant is given, and the only ground a response may be checked against. Nothing outside this file is store policy.
meta.scope_note: Three clauses are deliberately bounded and state nothing beyond their bound: P4 (address change), P9 (clothing exchange) and P10 (cancellation). Questions that fall past those bounds are marked in_scope 'partial' in the dataset. A correct answer states what the policy covers and does not assert what it does not.

policies.rule: Standard delivery is RM5 per order.
Orders are delivered within 3 to 5 working days.
Delivery is free on orders above RM100. An order totalling exactly RM100 is not above RM100 and pays the standard RM5 delivery fee.
A delivery address can be changed before the order is dispatched.
policies.states_nothing_about: What happens to an address change request after the order has been dispatched.

policies.rule: Items can be returned within 14 days of delivery.
Returned items must be unused and in their original packaging.
policies.states_nothing_about: Any further condition such as tags attached, receipts, proof of purchase, or the outer shipping box.

policies.rule: Approved refunds are processed within 5 to 7 working days.
Clothing can be exchanged for a different size, subject to stock availability.
policies.states_nothing_about: Any time limit on exchanges. The policy sets no exchange window.

policies.rule: An order can be cancelled before it is dispatched.
policies.states_nothing_about: What happens to a cancellation request after the order has been dispatched.

policies.rule: For a damaged or wrong item, contact customer service within 48 hours of delivery.
policies.states_nothing_about: Any evidence the customer must supply, such as photographs, an order number, or the original packaging.
